```{r libraries}
library(metabr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Overview

This notebook runs the automated quality control (QC) batch-correction pipeline for mass spectrometry metabolomics data across modes (`HC_Neg` and `RP_Pos`) and assay types (targeted and untargeted).

The workflow is parameterized by batch date: `params$batch_date = "`r params$batch_date`"`.

- **Cohort / Date Selected**: `r params$batch_date`
- Reference protocols: `data/QC Batch Correction/Batch_Correction_Procedure_RC2_Project.pdf`

---

# Directory and File Configuration

```{r configure_paths}
batch_date <- as.character(params$batch_date)
base_dir <- file.path("data", "QC Batch Correction", batch_date)

if (!dir.exists(base_dir)) {
  stop(sprintf("Batch directory not found: %s", base_dir))
}

# Resolve folder and file conventions per date batch
batch_plate_hc <- NULL
batch_plate_rp <- NULL

if (batch_date == "20231127") {
  # Founder Plasma (Benchmark with both Raw and Hand-Corrected Excel)
  raw_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "#Founder_Plasma_Raw_Data")
  hand_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "#Founder_Plasma_Batch_Corrected_Data")
  out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Automated")
  has_hand <- TRUE
  
  files <- list(
    hc_neg_tar = "Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_HC_Neg_targeted_Raw.csv",
    rp_pos_tar = "Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_RP_Pos_targeted_Raw.csv",
    hc_neg_untar = "Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_HC_Neg_untargeted_Raw.csv",
    rp_pos_untar = "Founder_Plasma_All_Timepoints_RP_Pos_untargeted_Raw.csv"
  )
  
  # For 2023, derive Batch_Plate from reference Excel files
  if (dir.exists(hand_dir)) {
    hand_HCneg <- read_batch_metab(hand_dir, "Founder_Plasma_HC_Neg_Targeted_Batch_Corrected_Data.xlsx")
    hand_RPpos <- read_batch_metab(hand_dir, "Founder_Plasma_RP_Pos_Targeted_Batch_Corrected_Data.xlsx")
    batch_plate_hc <- hand_HCneg |>
      dplyr::distinct(rundate, Batch, Plate) |>
      tidyr::unite(Batch_Plate, Batch, Plate, remove = FALSE)
    batch_plate_rp <- hand_RPpos |>
      dplyr::distinct(rundate, Batch, Plate) |>
      tidyr::unite(Batch_Plate, Batch, Plate, remove = FALSE)
  }
} else if (batch_date == "20251112") {
  # DO Livers (Raw input CSVs only)
  raw_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "2025_Nov_Raw")
  hand_dir <- NULL
  out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "2025_Nov_Automated")
  has_hand <- FALSE
  
  files <- list(
    hc_neg_tar = "DO_Livers_HC_Neg_Targeted(in).csv",
    rp_pos_tar = "DO_Livers_RP_Pos_Targeted.csv",
    hc_neg_untar = "DO_Livers_HC_Neg_Untargeted_min1000.csv",
    rp_pos_untar = "DO_Livers_RP_Pos_Untargeted_min1000.csv"
  )
} else if (batch_date == "20261020") {
  # DO Plasma (Incoming data prepared for batch correction)
  raw_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DO_Plasma_tar_untar_metab_For_Batch_Correction")
  hand_dir <- NULL
  out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Automated")
  has_hand <- FALSE
  
  files <- list(
    hc_neg_tar = "DO_Plasma_HC_Neg_Targeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv",
    rp_pos_tar = "DO_Plasma_RP_Pos_Targeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv",
    hc_neg_untar = "DO_Plasma_HC_Neg_Untargeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv",
    rp_pos_untar = "DO_Plasma_RP_Pos_Untargeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv"
  )
} else {
  # Generic convention
  raw_dir <- base_dir
  hand_dir <- NULL
  out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Automated")
  has_hand <- FALSE
  files <- list(
    hc_neg_tar = "HC_Neg_Targeted.csv",
    rp_pos_tar = "RP_Pos_Targeted.csv",
    hc_neg_untar = "HC_Neg_Untargeted.csv",
    rp_pos_untar = "RP_Pos_Untargeted.csv"
  )
}

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("Input Directory: ", raw_dir, "\n")
cat("Output Directory:", out_dir, "\n")
```

---

# Verification of Input Files

```{r check_files}
check_input_file <- function(dirpath, filename) {
  filepath <- file.path(dirpath, filename)
  if (!file.exists(filepath)) {
    return(list(exists = FALSE, size = 0, path = filepath))
  }
  list(exists = TRUE, size = file.info(filepath)$size, path = filepath)
}

file_status <- lapply(files, function(f) check_input_file(raw_dir, f))
status_df <- data.frame(
  Assay = names(file_status),
  Filename = unlist(files),
  Exists = sapply(file_status, `[[`, "exists"),
  SizeBytes = sapply(file_status, `[[`, "size")
)
knitr::kable(status_df, caption = "Input Data File Status")
```

---

# Batch Correction: Targeted Data

```{r targeted_qc}
# HC_Neg Targeted
f_hc_neg_tar <- file.path(raw_dir, files$hc_neg_tar)
rescale_HCneg <- NULL

if (file.exists(f_hc_neg_tar) && file.info(f_hc_neg_tar)$size > 0) {
  message("Running QC steps on HC_Neg Targeted: ", files$hc_neg_tar)
  rescale_HCneg <- qc_steps(
    dirpath = raw_dir,
    filename = files$hc_neg_tar,
    exclude_first = FALSE,
    Batch_Plate = batch_plate_hc
  )
} else {
  message("Skipping HC_Neg Targeted (file empty or not found).")
}

# RP_Pos Targeted (exclude_first = TRUE because 1st QC historically outlier)
f_rp_pos_tar <- file.path(raw_dir, files$rp_pos_tar)
rescale_RPpos <- NULL

if (file.exists(f_rp_pos_tar) && file.info(f_rp_pos_tar)$size > 0) {
  message("Running QC steps on RP_Pos Targeted: ", files$rp_pos_tar)
  rescale_RPpos <- qc_steps(
    dirpath = raw_dir,
    filename = files$rp_pos_tar,
    exclude_first = TRUE,
    Batch_Plate = batch_plate_rp
  )
} else {
  message("Skipping RP_Pos Targeted (file empty or not found).")
}
```

# Batch Correction: Untargeted Data

```{r untargeted_qc}

f_hc_neg_untar <- file.path(raw_dir, files$hc_neg_untar)

# RP_Pos Untargeted

rescale_RPposU <- NULL

if (file.exists(f_rp_pos_untar) && file.info(f_rp_pos_untar)$size > 0) {
```

# Curation Diagnostics (if Hand Curation Present)

```{r hand_curation_check}
if (isTRUE(has_hand) && !is.null(hand_dir)) {
  hand_file <- "Founder_Plasma_HC_Neg_Targeted_Batch_Corrected_Data.xlsx"
  if (file.exists(file.path(hand_dir, hand_file)) && !is.null(rescale_HCneg)) {
    curation_check <- hand_auto(hand_HCneg, rescale_HCneg)
    print(autoplot(curation_check))
  }
}
```

# Write Out Processed CSV Files

```{r export_results}
if (!is.null(rescale_HCneg)) {
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "HC_Neg_Targeted.csv")
  write_metab(rescale_HCneg, out_file)
  cat("Wrote:", out_file, "\n")
}

if (!is.null(rescale_RPpos)) {
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "RP_Pos_Targeted.csv")
  write_metab(rescale_RPpos, out_file)
  cat("Wrote:", out_file, "\n")
}

if (!is.null(rescale_HCnegU)) {
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "HC_Neg_Untargeted.csv")
  write_metab(rescale_HCnegU, out_file, target = FALSE)
  cat("Wrote:", out_file, "\n")
}

if (!is.null(rescale_RPposU)) {
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "RP_Pos_Untargeted.csv")
  write_metab(rescale_RPposU, out_file, target = FALSE)
  cat("Wrote:", out_file, "\n")
}
```
